Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Tsukimichi
Description:
A quest catalog for every journal type, with completed and available filters and a per-requirement breakdown of what still blocks a quest.
Moonlit treasures collects quests with unique rewards, and per-character snapshots keep the whole account in view.
Local only: no network code.
Punchline: Walk the moon's path: every quest, every requirement, every unique reward.
Changelog:
Welcome home

• What's new, in pictures. After each update, a short note like this one shows what changed. Past notes are in Settings, under What's new.
• Know when an update is ready. A quiet note in the status bar and a dot on the moon icon tell you. Update opens Dalamud's installer.
• A moon on your screen. A small moon opens Tsukimichi and shows what's next when you hover it. Move it, lock it or hide it.
• Faces for quest givers. Tsukimichi offers the optional portrait pack once. Nothing downloads unless you choose Download.
• At home in Umbra. Tsukimichi keeps clear of Umbra's toolbar, and an Umbra add-on puts Tonight in your Umbra bar.
